certified_zero_verification::certified_T.claim: CERTIFIED: all zeros up to T=5000 proven on the critical line via Arb ball arithmetic (4785 proven on-line zeros, matching N(T) at every 250-step checkpoint, no uncertified points). Halted: count/parity mismatch at T=5250 (proven=4785, N(T)=4787, uncertified=0).

de_bruijn_newman::lambda_lower_bound.claim: From the Lehmer pair at heights 5229.1986, 5229.2418 (index 4765, gap 0.04325): valid Lehmer pair ((5/4)delta^2 g_k=0.0107<1, g_k=4.5858), giving Lambda >= -2.341e-04. A genuine (modest) lower bound on the de Bruijn-Newman constant from a pair we discovered; consistent with RH (Lambda<=0 unproven) and with Lambda>=0 (Rodgers-Tao).

explicit_formula::n_zeros_used.claim: Explicit formula reconstructs psi(x) on 15 points (x in [10.5,80.5]): RMS residual 0.1257 with 200 zeros, down from 0.1540 with 100 zeros. Converging as predicted; consistent with RH.

lehmer_pairs::inverse_min_normalized_gap.claim: Resolved 267 zeros in (5000,5250]; closest pair at heights 5229.1986, 5229.2418 with raw gap 0.04325 and normalized gap delta=0.0463 (NEW lab record close pair (<0.291)). A genuine near-Lehmer pair; all gaps positive, consistent with RH.

lehmer_pairs::n_zeros_scanned.claim: Scanned first 300 zeros: smallest normalized gap 0.2911 between zeros #212 and #213 (heights 415.019, 415.455). All gaps positive; consistent with RH (no collision).

li_criterion::n_li_coefficients.claim: First 12 Keiper-Li coefficients estimated from 400 zeros are all positive (min lambda=0.0231) and increase from K=200 to K=400 (converging from below). Consistent with Li's criterion / RH.

robin_inequality::max_robin_ratio_CA.claim: Hunted 1456 colossally abundant numbers n>5040 (up to ln n=2788.8, ~1211 digits): max Robin ratio f=0.997887 < 1. No violation -> consistent with RH on the true extremal family (closest approach 0.997887).

robin_inequality::n_primorials_checked.claim: Robin's inequality holds for all 1995 primorials P_k > 5040 up to k=2000: max ratio f=0.77546 at k=6 (< 1). Consistent with RH on the primorial family.

zero_statistics::n_zeros_sampled.claim: First 200 zeta zeros: unfolded spacings fit GUE (KS=0.071) far better than Poisson (KS=0.353); mean gap 0.999. Consistent with Montgomery-Odlyzko.

zero_verification::T_verified.claim: All 341 nontrivial zeros with 0 < Im < 600.00 lie on the critical line: Hardy Z has exactly N(T)=341 sign changes.
